content.name: Wand of Secrets
entries: The wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges, and if a secret door or trap is within 30 feet of you, the wand pulses and points at the one nearest to you. The wand regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.

content.name: Wand of Secrets
entries: This wand has 3 charges and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to expend 1 charge, and if a secret door or trap is within 60 feet of you, the wand pulses and points at the one nearest to you.
